llm.summary: The skill's code and runtime instructions align with its stated purpose (generating stock reports and optionally pushing them to Feishu); required actions (network calls to public finance APIs, installing Python deps and fonts, optional use of the openclaw CLI to send messages) are proportional to that purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (stock report generator) match the included files: a Python report generator, helper scripts for scheduling/pushing, and an installer. Requested resources (matplotlib, pyppeteer, fonts, optional openclaw CLI) are consistent with generating charts, rendering HTML->PNG, and sending messages to Feishu.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and the scripts instruct the agent to read config.json, fetch stock/news data from public finance APIs (Sina/Eastmoney/Tencent), generate HTML/PNG outputs, and optionally push images via the openclaw CLI to Feishu. The instructions do not ask the agent to read unrelated system files or to exfiltrate arbitrary secrets.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No registry install spec (instruction-only), but an included install.sh runs pip installs (user scope), attempts to install system fonts via package managers (may call sudo), and pre-downloads Chromium using pyppeteer. These are expected for image generation but require elevated package-manager steps on some systems — review before running.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables or credentials. Pushing to Feishu uses the local 'openclaw message' CLI and a feishu.target_user configured in config.json — this is appropriate. Note: the openclaw CLI must already be configured with whatever credentials it needs; the skill itself does not request additional secrets.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not always-enabled and does not modify other skills or system-wide agent configs. It writes outputs to user-controlled output_dir and uses /tmp for logs — standard for this type of tool.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: fetch public market data, build charts, and optionally push reports to Feishu. Before installing, review install.sh because it may invoke package manager commands (sudo) to install fonts and will pre-download Chromium (network activity). If you plan to enable automated push to Feishu, ensure you trust the openclaw CLI configuration (it will be used to send files) and set feishu.target_user in config.json explicitly. If you want lower risk, run the scripts in a sandbox/container or inspect generate_report.py for any additional data sources you don't expect. Finally, never treat outputs as investment advice — the skill's disclaimer is appropriate.
